== Summary ==
Unscaled published-layout comparison for [[Jakku: Docking Bay (Errata 2)]]. First: [[:File:V7-L-jakkudockingbay.gif]]. Second: [[:File:V7-L-jakkudockingbay-Set7-September-2023-partial.png]], losslessly rotated for landscape reading. The official partial omits the artwork window; white is comparison-canvas background, not restored art. No card pixels repainted or sharpened. Official source [[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf]], page 4, image xref57, original transparency mask56. JPEG SHA-256 <code>55d1b9fc3cbe4deadb40d5b6db33340246bfdcead2de9726c6c00072e294dbec</code>; mask stream SHA-256 <code>f539467569b8e9064c4d283e65a6eeb0970442d2123a1324e4dc3759a7c5cd03</code>.
